glosses: To send (a shipment) with promptness.

examples.text: The League of One was suddenly exposed and in danger of being hunted by enemies of the salarians. examples.text: Scores of foreign journalists have been dispatched to Seoul to report on the growing tensions between the two Koreas and the possibility of war.
